pictures.author: ほっきー
pictures.observations: Entire960x720 current ordinary front view inspected. Heavy pale coursed-stone western facade, two faceted corner towers with ornate stepped pinnacles/crosses; high central pierced parapet/cross; large round-headed grilled window; pale sculptural portal screen with figures/niches, slender layered mouldings, round-arched tympanum, real dark entrance and short plaza stairs. Separate Town Hall left and cafe right remain context.

pictures.author: José Luis Filpo Cabana
pictures.observations: Entire500x500 ordinary night facade inspected. Layered doorway and tall arched grille, original simplified figure/niche rhythms and heavy stone towers; top cropped in photo, therefore complete silhouette established by2026 view. Plaza fountain is separate context.

pictures.author: (WT-shared) Shoestring
pictures.observations: Entire640x480 ordinary cloister passage picture inspected. Open pointed arcades, slender spiral shafts/capitals, ribbed passage ceiling and shared blue/white tile-like lower wall vocabulary. No narrative tile pictures copied.

pictures.author: Daderot
pictures.observations: Entire960x640 ordinary court view inspected after full image loaded. Four-wing court has lower pointed paired/traceried openings, projecting buttresses/pinnacles, upper dark glazed arcade, low tiled eaves, white higher rear range/red tile roof and tall white church side. Tiered central stone fountain. Specific bay counts, hidden roof layout, damage and painted tile narratives remain approximate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific standing Santa Cruz church and mapped monastery/cloister envelope in Coimbra: heavy western stone facade/twin faceted towers and ornate pinnacles, central pierced crest/cross, layered arched portal and tall recessed grilled window, white nave with terracotta roof, open pointed/traceried cloister arcades, upper dark windows/tile roofs, white outer ranges and original simplified central fountain. Shared stone/plaster/tile/wood/metal material graphs and original figure/foliage/spiral-shaft vocabulary; no copied narrative tile images, readable text or full church interior. Preserve Town Hall, Cafe Santa Cruz, other buildings, plaza and separate Manga monument.
